Title: Project setup: repo structure, README, .env.example, DB connection
User Story: As a team member, I want a documented frontend/backend skeleton with MongoDB connection so everyone can run the app locally.
Acceptance Criteria: frontend/ and backend/ exist; README lists setup/run steps; .env.example has no secrets; .env is git-ignored.

Title: Create student record
User Story: As an admin, I want to create a student with a unique student ID so the student appears in the list.
Acceptance Criteria: Valid student saved and visible in list; duplicate studentId rejected (409).

Title: View student details
User Story: As an admin, I want to open a student to see stored details.
Acceptance Criteria: Selecting a student shows all stored details.

Title: Update student details
User Story: As an admin, I want to edit a student's permitted details.
Acceptance Criteria: Updated values persist after refresh.

Title: Search students by ID or name
User Story: As an admin, I want to search students so I can find a record quickly.
Acceptance Criteria: Matches shown; no-match shows a clear message.

Title: Add room with unique number and positive capacity
User Story: As an admin, I want to add rooms so students can be allocated.
Acceptance Criteria: Valid room saved; duplicate room number or capacity <= 0 rejected.

Title: Show room capacity, occupancy and remaining capacity
User Story: As an admin, I want to see how full each room is.
Acceptance Criteria: Occupancy derived from active allocations and matches allocation records.

Title: Allocate student to a room
User Story: As an admin, I want to allocate a student to a room with free capacity.
Acceptance Criteria: Allocation recorded; occupancy updated.

Title: Reject allocation to a full room
User Story: As an admin, I want a clear error when a room is full.
Acceptance Criteria: No allocation created; clear error shown.

Title: Prevent duplicate active allocation per student
User Story: As an admin, I want a student to hold only one active allocation.
Acceptance Criteria: Second active allocation rejected (409) until first is ended.

Title: Change a student's room
User Story: As an admin, I want to move a student to another room.
Acceptance Criteria: Old allocation closed, new one recorded, capacity never exceeded.

Title: Vacate a room
User Story: As an admin, I want to mark a student as vacated.
Acceptance Criteria: Allocation ended with end date; room capacity increases.

Title: Filter rooms and allocations
User Story: As an admin, I want to filter by room availability and allocation status.
Acceptance Criteria: List shows only records matching the filter.

Title: Dashboard summary
User Story: As an admin, I want totals of students, rooms, occupancy and free capacity.
Acceptance Criteria: Summary values agree with stored records.

Title: Form validation and user-friendly error messages
User Story: As an admin, I want invalid/incomplete input explained and not saved.
Acceptance Criteria: Invalid input not saved; field-level messages shown.

Title: Server-side validation of all API input
User Story: As a maintainer, I want the backend to validate IDs, required fields, capacity and status values.
Acceptance Criteria: Invalid payload sent directly to API is rejected with no data change.

Title: Safe, consistent error handling
User Story: As a user, I never want stack traces or sensitive details in errors.
Acceptance Criteria: Invalid request returns consistent JSON message; no stack trace.

Title: Allocation data integrity (no overbooking, no contradictory records)
User Story: As an admin, I want occupancy never to exceed capacity even on repeated/concurrent requests.
Acceptance Criteria: Boundary and duplicate-allocation tests pass.

Title: Admin authentication/authorization with hashed passwords (conditional)
User Story: As an admin, I want login so only authorised users change records.
Acceptance Criteria: Unauthenticated write requests denied; passwords hashed. Build only if approved (HMS-033), else document as limitation.

Title: Performance check on list/search (<= 3 s)
User Story: As an admin, I want lists and searches to respond quickly.
Acceptance Criteria: 10 repeated list/search calls each under 3 s on demo data.

Title: Usability polish, responsive layout and Chromium check
User Story: As an admin, I want clear labels and a layout that works in Chrome.
Acceptance Criteria: Core workflows work in current Chromium browser at desktop resolution.

Title: Fee amount and payment status (optional extension)
User Story: As an admin, I want to record fee amount and Paid/Pending status.
Acceptance Criteria: Only if approved by instructor (HMS-033). Fee status saved and shown correctly.

Title: Allocation history per student (optional extension)
User Story: As an admin, I want to see past and active allocations of a student.
Acceptance Criteria: Only if approved. Past and active allocations distinguishable.

Title: Finalise test data set and test environment
User Story: As QA lead, I want sample students/rooms and a documented environment so tests are repeatable.
Acceptance Criteria: Demo dataset (incl. full-room and boundary cases) and environment steps documented in repo.

Title: Design allocation test cases (TC-ALLOC-001..007)
User Story: As QA lead, I want test cases for allocate, full room, duplicate, change and vacate.
Acceptance Criteria: Cases reviewed with PO; mapped in RTM.

Title: Design security, usability, performance and compatibility test cases
User Story: As QA lead, I want TC-SEC, TC-UX, TC-NFR, TC-COMP cases covering NFR/SR.
Acceptance Criteria: Each NFR/SR has at least one case with measurable pass criteria.

Title: Maintain RTM and triage defects
User Story: As QA lead, I want RTM kept current and defects triaged with the developer.
Acceptance Criteria: RTM status updated each sprint; defects have severity and owner.

Title: Run team usability check (NFR-001)
User Story: As QA lead, I want 5 demo users to attempt common tasks.
Acceptance Criteria: At least 4 of 5 users finish tasks unaided; results recorded.

Title: Test Summary Report
User Story: As QA lead, I want a final report of results, defects and coverage.
Acceptance Criteria: Report lists executed cases, pass/fail, open defects and RTM coverage.

Title: Design student and validation test cases (TC-STU, TC-ROOM)
User Story: As a tester, I want cases for student CRUD/search and room creation/validation.
Acceptance Criteria: Positive, negative and boundary cases written with expected results.

Title: Design filter and dashboard test cases; write API test scripts
User Story: As a tester, I want TC-FILT/TC-DASH cases plus automated API test scripts.
Acceptance Criteria: Scripts run from one command; results logged.

Title: Execute test cycles, log results and file defects (Sprint 1 and 2)
User Story: As a tester, I want to run all cases each sprint and report defects.
Acceptance Criteria: Execution logs and defect reports in repo; regression run before demo.

Title: Decide optional scope: login, fee tracking, allocation history
User Story: As PO, I want a documented decision with instructor so the MVP scope is fixed.
Acceptance Criteria: Decision recorded; conditional stories confirmed or dropped before Sprint 1 freeze.

Title: Refine backlog and confirm acceptance criteria
User Story: As PO, I want priorities and acceptance criteria agreed before sprint start.
Acceptance Criteria: Every story has priority, SP and acceptance criteria.

Title: Approve API contract and SAD alignment
User Story: As PO, I want the SAD API table to match the implemented endpoints.
Acceptance Criteria: SAD updated/approved against the code.

Title: Sprint reviews and test-result sign-off
User Story: As PO, I want to review each sprint and sign off results.
Acceptance Criteria: Sprint 1 and 2 review notes and sign-off recorded.

Title: Final demo preparation and deviation list
User Story: As PO, I want a demo script and a list of unimplemented requirements.
Acceptance Criteria: Demo script ready; deviations documented.
